newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht, interbank rates steady late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht, interbank rates steady late.

text.p: The Thai baht held steady in the domestic market in late quiet trade on Tuesday on easing dollar demand after heavy buying of the U.S. unit in the past few days, dealers said.
"Bids for dollars were much easier today. Most players should already cover their (dollar) positions after recent buying," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The baht was quoted at 25.850/25.950 to the dollar late in the onshore market against 25.850/25.910 in the early morning.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the midrate at 25.78 against 25.81 on Monday.
Tighter baht supply in the domestic banking system curbed interest in borrowing funds for dollar buying, dealers said.

In the offshore market, the baht eased to 25.400/25.600 in late trade from 24.800/25.300 in the morning. The one-month baht/dollar forward swap premium was quoted at 80/120 satangs per dollar offshore and 19/27 satangs in the domestic market.
The overnight interbank rate stood largely unchanged at 18-19 percent against 18-20 in the early morning.
"Liquidity should improve tomorrow. Dollar buying and swap premiums are easing," a money market dealer said.
